query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `funnel_branch_rules` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `funnel_page_id` int NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Untitled Rule',
  `priority` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `match_mode` enum('all','any') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all',
  `target_page_id` int,
  `target_url` varchar(2048),
  `is_active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `funnel_branch_conditions` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `rule_id` int NOT NULL,
  `variable` enum(
    'product_purchased','order_bump_selected','email_contains','email_domain',
    'purchase_price','source_url','utm_source','utm_medium','utm_campaign',
    'date_range','day_of_week','hour_of_day','country','device_type','custom_field'
  ) NOT NULL,
  `operator` enum(
    'equals','not_equals','contains','not_contains','starts_with','ends_with',
    'greater_than','less_than','between','in_list','not_in_list','is_set','is_not_set'
  ) NOT NULL,
  `value` varchar(1024) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
